title: Content worlds montage
slide_intent: Allow a shared framework to hold different visual languages so variety does not erase recognition.
strategic_value: The persistent green 4 can connect Channel 4 worlds ranging from illustration to architecture and sport.
demonstration: A ten-second montage holds the green logo centrally while switching among Stonehenge, soft forms, cellular objects, mirrored rooms, landscapes and other themed scenes.
practical_value: Compare which identity cue remains constant as image style and subject change.

content_islands.name: Stable signature
content_islands.spec: Retain the centered green 4 as the common point of reference.

content_islands.name: Changing worlds
content_islands.spec: Sequence distinct photographic, illustrated and dimensional settings behind it.

reference_purposes.Expression: The sequence combines varied themed imagery with a consistent green logo.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram explains that the worlds can contain functional content or elaborate narrative idents.
